messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired (P-4782) — high 95th percentile inference latency in us-west-2 (embeddings route). Alert threshold breached at 3135790246. https://pagerduty.com/incidents/P-4782
Alex: acked and taking it — I'm oncall. grabbing logs and perf dash :eyes:
Maya: thanks alex. can you confirm customer impact? any 5xxs or auth errors showing?
Alex: quick check: increased p95 from 120ms -> 3.2s; saw spike in 5xxs on /v1/embeddings route. sample error: `kv cache miss + oom` in several hosts. past 2m: ~400 errors/min.
Sanjay: adding context — autoscaler didn't spin new dedicated pods fast enough, and traffic fanout from a single heavy tenant triggered sequential KV cache thrash.
Priya: tagging support: @here some customers in prod experiencing intermittent embed failures — we've queued an outbound customer notification draft.
Liam: quick mitigation options: 1) scale up dedicated pool by +4 nodes (fast) 2) enable degraded fallback to smaller model `redwood-mini` for embeddings (possible quality regression) 3) route heavy tenant to eu region (latency/consistency risk).
Alex: doing 1) now — running `infra scale dedicated-pool us-west-2 --add 4` (may take 60-90s). also flipping prefix caching TTL to 30s for embeddings to reduce KV churn: `configset apply caching.rewrite=true caching.kv.ttl=30s`
Maya: :thumbsup: while that's happening, can someone post the quick runbook snippet so support has exact text for customers?
Priya: drafting customer ping: "We're investigating increased inference errors affecting embeddings in us-west-2. We're actively scaling capacity and applying mitigations; some requests may be retried automatically. We'll update within 15 minutes." copying to support channel now.
Sanjay: infra executed scale request at 3135790289, nodes provisioning. I'm also temporarily pinning the heavy tenant to single-worker backpressure: `rlimit apply tenant/TH-23 limit=30/s`
Alex: scale completed at 3135790324. p95 down to ~450ms, 5xxs dropping. keeping degraded fallback ready if we see rebound.
Liam: can we enable fallback now for a short window? Alex, want me to flip it to reduce errors further?
Alex: hold for 3 more mins and watch. if 5xxs < 50/min we keep stable.
Maya: logging decision: if errors < 50/min by 3135790426 we close as mitigated and start postmortem. otherwise escalate to SEV2 and run deeper KV heap analysis.
Priya: customer ping updated at 3135790340: "Mitigation in progress, error rates reducing. We'll confirm stability in 5-10 mins."
IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: PagerDuty note added by Alex: "Scaled dedicated pool + applied tenant rate-limit; monitoring p95 and 5xxs."
Alex: quick status at 3135790368 — p95 ~320ms, 5xxs ~18/min. marking as being handled, will follow up with a short postmortem tomorrow. anyone taking lead on the write-up?
Maya: I'll own the postmortem. grabbing logs and perf traces now.
Sanjay: leaving follow-up to infra to audit autoscaler config and propose a policy tweak (burst headroom + faster spin-up).
Priya: closing customer loop once postmortem is ready.
Liam: :thumbsup: nice quick run — keep an eye on kv eviction counters for the next 24h.
Alex: thanks all. moving to monitoring-only; ping me if it creeps back. :relieved:
